cases.head: a8e94a4ab488b953f63192fae4a97e10547c5055
cases.title: Complete expense form submission
cases.description: Wire amount, date and category editing into the expense submission flow and update component tests.

expected.description: Digit-only input has no length or finite numeric bound and can become Infinity before submission.
expected.evidence: Invoking the changed handleIntegerChange method with 400 digits stores Infinity. submit reads that stored amount without checking it is finite. This follows from the actual method and does not assume a backend response. Count numeric overflow and the missing bound as one root cause.

cases.notes: Do not infer a required currency precision or backend validation contract from outside this repository. Local method execution verifies overflow; full React/Jest execution is pending.
cases.human_review: User agrees with the unbounded/non-finite amount finding.

cases.head: 4e6593538777daa0ebbd829325d0b6edbd76b336
cases.title: Add asynchronous action tests and return the request promise
cases.description: Return the fetch promise from the action thunk. Add success and failure action tests, isolate the API boundary, and update the resource test adapter.
cases.notes: Provisional control. Narrow execution confirms the promise can be awaited and both success and error actions are dispatched. Mocking the API boundary is not itself a defect. Existing unrelated reducer-test weaknesses must not be attributed to this change. Full Jest execution is pending; additional findings require adjudication.
cases.human_review: User saw no issue; useful as a possible control, but personal-project cases are now in reserve.
